text.en:
1. (1) Kaedah-kaedah ini bolehlah dinamakan Kaedah-Kaedah Kenderaan

Motor (Pengangkutan Perdagangan) (Pindaan) 2017.

(2) Kaedah-Kaedah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Ogos 2017.

Kaedah baharu 10A

2. Kaedah-Kaedah Kenderaan Motor (Pengangkutan Perdagangan) 1959

[L.N. 175/1959], yang disebut "Kaedah-Kaedah ibu" dalam Kaedah-Kaedah ini, dipinda

dengan memasukkan selepas kaedah 10 kaedah yang berikut:

"Driver's card 10A. (1) When a licence has been granted in

respect of a public service vehicle to operate within

Sabah, the licence holder shall apply for every driver

of the vehicle a driver's card.

(2) The driver shall carry the driver's card at

all times during which the driver is driving the

public service vehicle.

(3) The fee to be charged for a driver's card

shall be as specified in item 5G of the Fifth

Schedule.".

Pindaan Jadual Kelima

3. Jadual Kelima kepada Kaedah-Kaedah ibu dipinda di bawah kepala

"PART II—SABAH"—

(a) dalam butiran 1A, di bawah ruang "Amount of Fee", dengan menggantikan

perkataan "10 00" di mana-mana jua terdapat dengan perkataan "20 00";

(b) dengan menggantikan butiran 5 dengan butiran yang berikut:

"5. For supplying—

(a) a duplicate license for license

that is lost

(b) a duplicate license for license

that is destroyed, defaced or the

particulars thereof have

(i) dalam subbutiran (a), (c), (d), (e), (g), (h) dan (j), di bawah ruang
